title: T1-T12 AR ROM after anterior rib cage removal (Watkins 2005, secondary)
subcategory: long segment with rib cage, stepwise reduction

quantity.name: ROM
quantity.definition: overall T1-T12 ROM (full range), mean (SD not reported in secondary sources)

source.authors: Watkins R 4th, Watkins R 3rd, Williams L, Ahlbrand S, Garcia R, Karamanian A, Sharp L, Vo C, Hedman T
source.sample: 10 human T1-T12 thoracic spines with rib cage and sternum (values via secondary sources)

protocol.summary: Pure moments 2 Nm in FE and LB, 5 Nm + 50 N axial preload in AR (automated test machine); stepwise: intact, transverse sternal fracture, anterior rib cage removal up to rib stumps.
how_to_simulate: Model T1-T12 with rib cage and sternum; apply the resection of this step
Apply pure moment (2 Nm FE/LB; 5 Nm AR with 50 N axial compressive preload) at T1, T12 fixed
protocol.notes: PDF of Watkins 2005 not in download folder; values taken from secondary sources (see extraction.from). Ranges from Mannen 2015 Table 3.

pass_rule.rule: model within [min,max] of specimens (median as target)

ribcage.intact_structures: rib stumps with costovertebral/costotransverse joints only

resection.step_name: rib cage removed up to rib stumps (costovertebral/costotransverse joints kept)
sequence: transverse sternal fracture at the sternomanubrial junction
rib cage removed up to rib stumps (costovertebral/costotransverse joints kept)
